art_note: The lifestyle shots use heavy digital compositing with tropical beaches pasted behind studio model cutouts, diminishing luxury credibility.
desc_en: Elevated and distinctive, this Hawaiian shirt redefines the codes of relaxed tailoring. Crafted from a fluid blend of polyester and elastane, it offers a soft touch and seamless comfort. Each panel is individually cut and sewn to ensure the print maintains flawless continuity. A versatile garment designed for the season, bringing a sophisticated accent to any contemporary wardrobe. Available exclusively made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Elevada y distintiva, esta camisa hawaiana redefine los códigos de la sastrería relajada. Confeccionada con una mezcla fluida de poliéster y elastano, ofrece un tacto suave y una comodidad impecable. Cada panel se corta y cose de manera individual para asegurar que el estampado mantenga una continuidad perfecta. Una prenda versátil diseñada para la temporada, que aporta un acento sofisticado a cualquier guardarropa contemporáneo. Disponible exclusivamente bajo demanda con envíos a todo el mundo.
